title: Pan-Fried Cajun Tofu with Zucchini & Carrot Rice Pilaf

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, carrots, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Add to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water.
When the veggies are tender, add rice and broth to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Cook rice pilaf until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, Cajun seasoning, and salt; gently stir to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 7-8 minutes; remove to a plate.
To serve, divide rice pilaf and tofu between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
